rounds.text: Servotech Renewable Power System Ltd demonstrates exceptional top-line and bottom-line compounding, evidenced by a 5-year compounded sales growth of 49% and an extraordinary 5-year compounded profit growth of 102% [E15, E19]. This rapid expansion significantly outpaces sector medians, supported by strong recent performance metrics including a 69% year-on-year sales jump and a 38% year-on-year net profit increase [E62, E64]. Operating efficiency is also on an upward trajectory, with operating margins expanding by 4 percentage points over three years to reach 11% in the trailing twelve months [E29]. Market strength is further validated by a solid rules-based screen score of 76 out of 100 resulting in a medium-confidence buy rating alongside a healthy relative-strength rating of 72 against the Nifty 500 [E49, E61]. Conceded: [E35, E43].
